Hi Lisa —

Thanks again for the time last week. Attached is the renewal + capacity add-on proposal for Q4 (summary + line items). To make sure we bill cleanly and avoid a renewal delay, can you confirm the following so Finance can generate the invoice and match your PO: 

- Billing entity name and remit-to address (legal payee)
- Preferred billing contact and email for invoices (we usually send to invoices@company.com)
- Whether SlateWave will provide a PO (and if so the PO number)
- Preferred net terms (we proposed Net30; you mentioned Net45 during the call)
- Tax form: do you need our W-9 or W-8 (if non-US)?

If you can send a PO or confirm the remit info this week we can lock pricing and start the DocuSign signature flow. I cc'd Marissa (your AM) and Grace (finance) so they can jump in on invoice/EIN details.

Next steps I suggest:
1) You confirm billing contact + remit entity by EOD Thu
2) Procurement issues PO referencing DEAL-23894
3) We countersign and Grace issues the invoice referencing the PO

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
